name: plugin.google_adk_docs_navigator
description: Google ADK documentation, API reference retriever (Python/TS/Go/Kotlin), and llms.txt index navigator.

entrypoints.name: adk_docs_search
entrypoints.description: Search ADK documentation, architecture guides, tutorials, and concepts

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keywords or search term to look up

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matched sections to return

entrypoints.name: adk_get_api_reference
entrypoints.description: Retrieve official API references and code signatures for ADK across Python, TypeScript, Go, or Kotlin

parameters.name: symbol_name
parameters.description: Name of class, method, or interface (e.g. 'Agent', 'BaseTool', 'SessionService')

entrypoints.name: adk_fetch_llms_txt
entrypoints.description: Fetch structured plain-text documentation sections optimized for AI agent consumption

parameters.name: full_content
parameters.description: Whether to return full llms-full.txt content or brief index
